description: Is this payment rail closed on this date, or on which days is it closed this year? Free: rule-based closing days for TARGET (ECB T2), Ireland and UK bank holiday calendars (England and Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland). Give date=YYYY-MM-DD for closed true/false with reason, or year=YYYY for the list of closures. TARGET also closes on weekends; IE and UK calendars list holidays only. IE weekend substitution days are not modelled. 60 calls/min per client.

calendar.description: One of target, ie, uk-ew, uk-sco, uk-ni

year.description: Year YYYY, returns all closures (give year or date)

name: check_rail_calendar
